title: [FLINK-41054][metrics] Add exclude filter for the metric query service
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

The JobManager's `MetricStore` only ever adds metrics; entries are retained until the job is removed. Metrics registered under a dynamically created group therefore accumulate indefinitely in the REST API. The per-split watermark metrics introduced by FLIP-513 are keyed by split id, so for sources with many splits `/jobs/:jobid/vertices/:vertexid/subtasks/metrics` keeps returning entries for every split the source has ever read, even though the TaskManager side closes the split metric group once the split finishes (FLINK-37596, FLINK-40549).

This PR introduces `metrics.internal.query-service.filter.excludes`, a filter applied before a metric is handed to the `MetricQueryService`. It mirrors the existing per-reporter `filter.excludes` syntax. Excluded metrics are still delivered to metric reporters, which receive proper unregister notifications and are therefore unaffected by the leak. The option defaults to excluding the split watermark metrics (`*.operator.split.watermark:*:*`); an empty value exposes them again.

This is a mitigation for the specific unbounded case rather than a fix of the add-only `MetricStore`. Fixing the store to drop metrics that no longer appear in a TaskManager dump is a larger change that can be tracked separately.

## Brief change log

  - Add `MetricOptions.QUERY_SERVICE_EXCLUDES` (`metrics.internal.query-service.filter.excludes`), a list option using the reporter filter format, defaulting to the split watermark scope.
  - Add `DefaultReporterFilters.queryServiceMetricsFromConfiguration`, which builds a `ReporterFilter<Metric>` with an implicit include-all and the configured excludes.
  - `MetricRegistryConfiguration` parses the filter once at startup, logs the resolved exclude list at INFO, and falls back to the default with a WARN if the value cannot be parsed.
  - `MetricRegistryImpl.register` evaluates the filter against the metric's logical scope before calling `MetricQueryService.addMetric`. Reporter notification and unregistration are unchanged.
  - Document the option (regenerated `metric_configuration.html`) and note on the Split metrics table in `docs/content/docs/ops/metrics.md` that these metrics reach reporters only by default.

## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

  - `MetricRegistryImplTest#testQueryServiceExcludesSplitWatermarkMetricsByDefault` registers a gauge under a real `taskmanager.job.task.operator.split.watermark` group hierarchy and asserts that a reporter receives it while the query service dump does not.
  - `MetricRegistryImplTest#testQueryServiceExcludesAreConfigurable` asserts that a configured pattern excludes a matching metric from the query service dump while others remain.
  - `DefaultReporterFiltersTest#testQueryServiceFilterExcludesSplitWatermarkMetricsByDefault` and `#testQueryServiceFilterFromConfiguration` cover the default filter, multiple entries, type-scoped entries, and that a configured list replaces the default rather than extending it.
  - `DefaultReporterFiltersTest#testQueryServiceFilterWithoutExcludesExposesSplitWatermarkMetrics` covers both the empty list and the empty flat string form.
  - Both registry tests were verified to fail with the filter check removed and to pass with it.
  - `ConfigOptionsDocsCompletenessITCase` passes against the regenerated documentation.

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): no
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: yes, a new option is added to `MetricOptions` (`@PublicEvolving`). No existing option or signature changes.
  - The serializers: no
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): no. The filter runs once per metric registration, in the same place the reporter filters already run.
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: no
  - The S3 file system connector: no

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? yes
  - If yes, how is the feature documented? docs (generated config reference and the Split section of the metrics page) and JavaDocs
